name: Nyxium
what: Agentic AI platform (geospatial AI plus regulatory data) that speeds up site selection and permitting for energy infrastructure: nuclear/SMRs, solar, wind, storage and data centres.
homonym_note: Not Nyxion, the founder's earlier environmental-intelligence company mentioned in the same release.
